title: cyclaminus neapolitana
intro: Cyclaminus neapolitana, commonly known as Neapolitan cyclamen, is a perennial flowering plant native to the Mediterranean region. This plant is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, that may aid in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Neapolitan cyclamen are attributed to its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, making it a popular natural remedy for anxiety and insomnia. The bioactive constituents of Neapolitan cyclamen include alkaloids, glycosides, and flavonoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
